adaptation: Original game dialogue; not a translation or quotation of traditional stories.
speaker_ids_are_proposed: Resolve aliases against the existing catalogue; do not create duplicates.

lines.speaker: esi
lines.text: A name is not a gift from a throne. It is something we owe each other.
lines.direction: Public performance; conversational, not an exposition speech.

lines.speaker: guard
lines.text: By order of the court, these names are struck from the river roll.
lines.direction: Practised official announcement; no caricatured accent.

lines.speaker: market_witness
lines.text: That is my father. He built this landing.
lines.direction: Quiet disbelief before anger.

lines.speaker: kwaku
lines.text: Who told the river he never lived?
lines.direction: Understated challenge, not a joke at the witness's expense.

lines.speaker: aso-yaa
lines.text: Lower your voice. Look at the seal.
lines.direction: Close, urgent; move naturally into playable inspection.

lines.speaker: kwaku
lines.text: New wax. The old impression is underneath.
lines.direction: Observation made while the player inspects the edict.

lines.speaker: aso-yaa
lines.text: Then find the original ledger. A broken seal is a question. We need an answer.
lines.direction: Give an objective and a reason.

lines.speaker: kojo
lines.text: You notice the missing ink. I remember the people beneath it.
lines.direction: Measured; no supernatural memory exposition.

lines.speaker: kwaku
lines.text: Will you tell the market what you remember?
lines.direction: A direct request.

lines.speaker: kojo
lines.text: Bring proof. Memory should not have to stand alone.
lines.direction: Resolve, not distrust of the witness.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: River gate. First bell. Count the boats, not the banners.
lines.direction: An original fictional password; easily distinguishable rhythm.

lines.speaker: kwaku
lines.text: River gate. First bell. Count the boats, not the banners.
lines.direction: Ability imitation by the same consenting cast; not a cloned real person.

lines.speaker: guard
lines.text: The call is right. Keep your hands where I can see them.
lines.direction: Grants bounded access, not permanent immunity.

lines.speaker: guard
lines.text: You said you came from the river. Why are your feet dry?
lines.direction: Telegraph contradiction before escalating suspicion.

lines.speaker: kwaku
lines.text: Because your captain sent me by the upper road. Ask him after the bell.
lines.direction: Valid only when the upper-road evidence token is owned.

lines.speaker: aso-yaa
lines.text: I can put my seal on your passage. But the ledger names living witnesses.
lines.direction: Clearly identify the ethical cost.

lines.speaker: kwaku
lines.text: You want them kept out of the story.
lines.direction: A question presented as recognition.

lines.speaker: aso-yaa
lines.text: Out of the court's reach. Not out of our memory. Promise me that.
lines.direction: Firm; preserves witness dignity.

lines.speaker: kwaku
lines.text: I promise.
lines.direction: Only play after explicit player acceptance.

lines.speaker: guard
lines.text: The Ledger-Keeper's seal. Through the left door.
lines.direction: Permit has a specific destination.

lines.speaker: kwaku
lines.text: The watcher can see the door. Not the space above it.
lines.direction: Short hint after a delay, not on every attempt.

lines.speaker: guard
lines.text: Who is on that roof?
lines.direction: Threat location readable in captions.

lines.speaker: kwaku
lines.text: One story here. Another over there.
lines.direction: Trick Mirror gesture cue; avoid talking over player feedback.

lines.speaker: kwaku
lines.text: They did not lose the names. They moved them.
lines.direction: Discovery, restrained.

lines.speaker: kojo
lines.text: From the river roll to the list of enemies.
lines.direction: Companion delivery only when Kojo is present; otherwise use a readable annotation.

lines.speaker: kwaku
lines.text: And every witness is written beside them.
lines.direction: Make the final choice understandable.

lines.speaker: osebo
lines.text: Put the ledger down. Walk away with your own name intact.
lines.direction: Controlled menace; intelligibility above loudness.

lines.speaker: kwaku
lines.text: Is that an offer or the next correction?
lines.direction: Keeps moving; no forced stop.

lines.speaker: osebo
lines.text: Close the river gates!
lines.direction: Triggers through an idempotent gameplay event, not audio completion.

lines.speaker: esi
lines.text: The boats! I can keep their eyes on me.
lines.direction: One timely navigation cue.

lines.speaker: kofi
lines.text: If you are boarding, board. If you are arguing, swim.
lines.direction: Brief character humour after clear navigation cue.

lines.speaker: esi
lines.text: Show it to them, and they will know who was erased.
lines.direction: Explain benefit of exposure.

lines.speaker: aso-yaa
lines.text: Show every page, and the court will know who helped you.
lines.direction: Explain exposure risk; not a binary good/evil framing.

lines.speaker: kwaku
lines.text: There has to be a way to keep the truth without offering them our people.
lines.direction: Acknowledge incomplete alternatives; do not promise an unavailable third branch.

lines.speaker: esi
lines.text: These names were changed by order. Here is the seal. Here is the hand that changed them.
lines.direction: Public account follows actual evidence ownership.

lines.speaker: market_witness
lines.text: Say his name again.
lines.direction: Personal payoff before systemic consequence.

lines.speaker: aso-yaa
lines.text: Now we move the witnesses. Every one we still can.
lines.direction: Consequence, not celebration without cost.

lines.speaker: aso-yaa
lines.text: I lent you my name because you gave me your word.
lines.direction: Conditional line only if negotiation promise was made.

lines.speaker: kwaku
lines.text: Not this page. Not while they can use it to find them.
lines.direction: Deliberate withholding, not destruction of evidence.

lines.speaker: esi
lines.text: Then I will tell the names I can stand beside. The rest we keep safe.
lines.direction: No magical universal update of public belief.

lines.speaker: kojo
lines.text: A story can wait. A person cannot always wait with it.
lines.direction: Measured aftermath.

lines.speaker: ananse
lines.text: You have learned that a thread can bind two people, or tighten around one.
lines.direction: The spider is a separate character; no silent Kwaku identity retcon.

lines.speaker: kwaku
lines.text: Which did I weave?
lines.direction: Unresolved accountability.

lines.speaker: ananse
lines.text: Ask the people holding the other end.
lines.direction: Charismatic, formidable through insight; no lore dump.
